title: Prefix cache
brief: Index token blocks in a radix tree, name them with a parent hash, and place recurrent-state checkpoints under a byte budget.
hints: Hash the parent hash together with this block's token ids. The same 16 tokens after two different prefixes are different blocks.
Evict a leaf whose reference count is zero. An interior node still has a child, so it stays until that child is gone.
A checkpoint costs 154,927,104 bytes. A prompt uses the rightmost checkpoint at or before its length, and that checkpoint is the tokens you skip.
